text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This festival too 
was truly a splendid one.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
......Truly, it was a splendid thing to 
behold.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite a while since we all 
gathered like this. 
---Thank you all for your hard work.
choice_data_list:
Likewise, thank you so much for all your 
support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few months have passed since the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai. 
I offer my sincere thanks once again to 
everyone involved in the rituals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The festival's success was all thanks to 
their dedicated support. 
Looking around at all the familiar 
faces---

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Well, I don't see Azuma-san anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Votive Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Azuma-san? 
......

text_block_list.name: Votive Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
......Forgive me. 
Who might you be referring to?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Prayers calling forth a horsegirl's name 
shall surely become an irreplaceable 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
......A power capable of transcending 
worlds.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
That I was able to exist in this world 
until now... must surely 
be by virtue of that very power as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I make my way to the archive where 
Azuma-san had led me before. 
Perhaps here, she might---

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLANG! Clatter, clatter, clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the old horseshoe lying on the 
floor. 
Something was engraved on its reverse 
side.

---Thank you. To the one who called my 
name.

---Thank you. To the one who will call my 
name.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I could have sworn I heard a voice just 
now. 
Whose could that have been---

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What in the world are you doing here? 
Everyone was making a huge fuss 
because you completely vanished, you know!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......Still, to think there was a 
storehouse 
like this. Were you searching for 
something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...What was I searching for, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, ancient texts and scrolls 
are lined up across the shelves. Perhaps I 
had 
come looking for historical documents.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... 
Why are you spacing out on me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have any business here, come 
on! 
Our dinner party with everyone's about to 
start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led along by Daiwa Scarlet, I join 
all the other Goshiki Shuntaisai 
participants once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, all of a sudden---

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ---I felt a gentle breeze brush past.
